cards.name: Karim Raaji
cards.text: I spent years relying on tools like Power Query to extract and clean financial data from PDFs. They worked — but never cleanly, and the maintenance was constant. Finding Altera was a turning point. The extraction is accurate, the setup took minutes, and for the price it's an absolute game changer for anyone who works with financial documents on a daily basis.

cards.name: Jonathan Ashton
cards.text: I found myself juggling multiple tools just to get data out of a PDF — one app for conversion, others for cleaning. But the bigger issue was privacy. Working with client data under NDA, I couldn't afford to have files processed on a third-party server. Most tools I tried did exactly that. Altera was the first solution that actually understood the core problem and solved it — everything runs locally, on my machine, and the results are clean from the start.

cards.name: Mohammed Amine Bendidi
cards.text: Receiving volumes of data — mostly PDFs — with tight deadlines was a constant nightmare. We had skilled developers in our data lab, but the gap between what they built and what we actually needed never fully closed. Altera was different. It didn't come from a team that just knew how to code — it came from people who had lived the problem firsthand. That shows in every feature. A solution built by analysts, for analysts.

cards.name: Thomas Reeves
cards.text: What sets Altera apart from anything in the Microsoft ecosystem is that it's actually extensible in a meaningful way. With Excel or Power BI, you're locked into what exists — if a feature isn't there, you wait, and most of the time it never comes. With Altera, if a node doesn't cover your exact use case, the team will build it for you. They can extend existing nodes or create fully custom ones from scratch. That kind of responsiveness is something enterprise software simply doesn't offer.

allFaqs.label: What types of PDFs does Altera support?
allFaqs.text: Altera works with any PDF — payslips, invoices, bank statements, reports, and more. If it has structured data, Altera can extract it.

allFaqs.label: How accurate is the extraction?
allFaqs.text: Altera extracts data with high accuracy. You can define custom rules to ensure every field maps exactly where you need it.

allFaqs.label: Do I need to install anything?
allFaqs.text: Altera is a standalone desktop app. Download the installer for Windows or macOS and you're ready to start extracting in seconds — no other software required.

allFaqs.label: Can I process multiple PDFs at once?
allFaqs.text: Yes. Altera supports batch processing so you can drop in hundreds of PDFs and get all the data structured in one go.

allFaqs.label: Is my data secure?
allFaqs.text: Your files are processed securely and never stored beyond the active session. We don't share or retain your data.

allFaqs.label: Can I try it before paying?
allFaqs.text: Absolutely — you can start for free and explore the core features before committing to a plan.

allFaqs.label: Do I need programming knowledge to use Altera?
allFaqs.text: Not at all. Altera is designed to be used entirely visually — you drag, drop, and configure — no code required.

allFaqs.label: Can Altera handle scanned or image-based PDFs?
allFaqs.text: Altera works best with digitally generated PDFs. Scanned documents with OCR-readable text are also supported, though accuracy may vary depending on scan quality.

allFaqs.label: What output format does the extracted data come in?
allFaqs.text: Altera outputs clean, structured tables directly in the app — ready to analyse, export, or feed into your next workflow step.

allFaqs.label: Can I use different nodes for different document types?
allFaqs.text: Yes. Each node is purpose-built for a specific extraction task. You can mix and match nodes in the same workflow to handle different document types in one pass.

allFaqs.label: What if the extraction misses a field or gets it wrong?
allFaqs.text: You can define custom extraction rules to handle edge cases. If a specific document structure isn't covered out of the box, we also offer custom node development.

allFaqs.label: Is there a file size limit?
allFaqs.text: Altera handles standard business documents without issue. Very large files or unusually complex layouts may affect processing time, but there is no hard cap.

allFaqs.label: What languages are supported?
allFaqs.text: Altera primarily supports English and French documents. Support for additional languages is being added as the suite grows.

allFaqs.label: How do I get support if something goes wrong?
allFaqs.text: You can reach us directly at support@alteradatasuite.com. We're a small team so you'll always get a real response — not a bot.

about.heroHeading: Built by a small team with a clear goal.
about.heroLead: Altera Data Suite was created to solve a problem we kept running into — extracting structured data from PDFs shouldn't require hours of manual work or complex scripts. So we built a tool that does it in seconds.
about.story1Text: We both came from consulting backgrounds — working with firms including Deloitte and PwC. One thing became clear fast: even at that level, nobody had built a proper all-in-one solution for extracting data from PDFs. Payslips, invoices, reports — everything was handled manually or with fragile one-off scripts. That gap was the starting point.
about.story2Text: We started with a single PDF converter node. It worked — and immediately we saw what was missing next. Getting a table out of a PDF was only step one; cleaning it, reshaping it, and getting it ready to actually use took just as long. So we kept building. Each new node was a direct response to a friction point in real workflows.
about.story3Text: The early versions were built to run inside another company's software. That got us moving fast, but it also meant living within someone else's constraints. So we rebuilt Altera as its own desktop app — full control over speed, design, and the experience end to end, with nothing else to install first.
about.story4Text: The suite is still growing. More nodes are in development, existing ones are actively maintained, and AI is becoming a core part of how Altera extracts, interprets, and structures data. This isn't a finished product — it's an evolving toolkit built to keep pace with how data work actually happens.
about.ctaHeading: Ready to see it in action?
about.ctaSubtitle: Watch the demo to see how Altera handles real PDFs, or explore the pricing to find the plan that fits.

team.bio: Mehdi built Altera to remove the friction from data extraction. As CEO, he defines the product vision, steers the technical roadmap, and makes sure every feature is grounded in actual data professional needs — delivering fast, scalable, and purposeful tools.

Salah leads the company's commercial and marketing strategy. He is responsible for brand development, customer acquisition, lead generation, and strategic partnerships. His goal is to accelerate the company's growth and promote innovative document automation solutions to professionals.

Saumya specializes in Rust, C, and TypeScript, with a sharp focus on software performance optimization. He architects the core engine behind Altera, ensuring every computation is fast, lean, and built to scale.

Raphaël crafts the interfaces users interact with every day. Specializing in frontend engineering, he transforms designs into fast, responsive, and accessible web experiences. From component architecture to pixel-perfect implementation, he ensures Altera's UI is smooth, reliable, and consistent — bridging the gap between design intent and real user interaction.

quickReplies.question: How does PDF Converter work?
quickReplies.answer: Open your PDF, draw rectangles over the data you want to extract, optionally place column guides, then click Convert. You get a clean structured table ready for further processing.

quickReplies.question: What nodes are available?
quickReplies.answer: Altera includes 9 nodes: PDF Converter, Filter Builder, Column Manager, Rows Slicer, Header Promoter, Multi Shift Columns, Regex Extractor, Remove Duplicates, and Cleaner.

quickReplies.question: How does pricing work?

items: License is machine-bound using unique machine identification
License validation requires internet connectivity at least once every 7 days
You may not crack, keygen, or attempt to circumvent license validation mechanisms

sections.heading: 2. Prohibited Uses
sections.body: You agree not to:
items: Use the software for illegal purposes or in violation of any applicable laws
Share, sell, or distribute your license key to third parties
Attempt to reverse-engineer, decompile, or extract proprietary code
Use the software to bulk-scrape, mine, or extract data for competitive purposes

sections.heading: 3. AI Accuracy Disclaimer
sections.body: The REGEX AI Generator and data extraction features use artificial intelligence and are not 100% accurate. Results may vary based on input quality, document complexity, and data formatting. Users are responsible for validating extracted data before using it in production environments.

sections.heading: 4. Trial Terms
sections.body: The 7-day free trial is limited to one per machine. After the trial expires, a paid license is required to continue using Altera. You may cancel the trial at any time without penalty.

sections.heading: 5. Updates & Maintenance
sections.body: Minor updates and bug fixes are provided free during your subscription. We reserve the right to discontinue features or major versions with 30-day notice. Core functionality will remain available during your active license term.

sections.heading: 6. Data & Privacy
sections.body: All user data is processed locally on your machine. Extraction patterns and regex outputs are transmitted to our servers only for AI processing and are not permanently stored. See the Privacy Policy for complete details.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Altera Data Suite is provided 'as-is' without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for data loss, extraction errors, or damages resulting from the use or misuse of this software. Users assume all responsibility for validating outputs before relying on them.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect the following information:
items: Account Information: Your email address and name (for license registration)
Machine ID: A unique identifier to bind your license to your computer
Usage Data: Information about which features you use (for product improvement)
AI Processing Data: Regex patterns and documents sent to our AI servers for processing (not permanently stored)

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: Your information is used to:
items: Validate and authenticate your license
Process your AI requests (regex generation, data extraction)
Improve and optimize our services
Send important updates and license renewal reminders

sections.heading: 3. Payment Processing
sections.body: All payment processing is handled by Paddle (our payment processor). We do not store your credit card information. Credit card data is encrypted and processed directly by Paddle according to their privacy standards and PCI compliance requirements.

sections.heading: 4. AI Prompts & Server Processing
sections.body: When you use the REGEX AI Generator, your prompts and documents are transmitted to our AI servers for processing. We do not permanently store these inputs. However, we recommend not including sensitive, confidential, or private information (such as personal identifiers, account numbers, or confidential business information) in your prompts. If you have trust concerns about data transmission, we suggest using only non-sensitive test data.

sections.heading: 5. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your data as follows:
items: Account Information: Stored while your license is active; deleted 30 days after cancellation
Machine ID: Retained for license validation; deleted upon request
AI Processing Data: Not permanently stored after processing

sections.heading: 6. Third-Party Services
sections.body: We use the following third-party services:
items: Paddle: Payment processing and merchant services
DeepSeek API: AI processing for regex generation
Email Service Provider: For sending license keys and notifications

sections.heading: 7. GDPR & CCPA Rights
sections.body: If you are located in the EU (GDPR) or California (CCPA), you have the right to:
items: Request a copy of your personal data
Request deletion of your data
Opt-out of marketing communications
sections.note: To exercise these rights, email us at: support@alteradatasuite.com

sections.heading: 8. Security
sections.body: We use industry-standard encryption and security practices to protect your data. However, no system is 100% secure. We are not liable for unauthorized access due to factors beyond our control.

sections.heading: 9. Contact Us
sections.body: For privacy questions or data requests: support@alteradatasuite.com

sections.heading: 1. 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee
sections.body: If you are not satisfied with Altera Data Suite within your first 30 days of purchase, we offer a full refund. No questions asked. To request a refund, email support@alteradatasuite.com with your license key and reason for the refund.

sections.heading: 2. Refund Eligibility

items: Request is made within 30 days of purchase
The license has not been shared or transferred to another user
No evidence of attempting to circumvent license restrictions

sections.heading: 3. Refund Processing

sections.heading: 4. Trial Refund Policy
